answer: Sybil defense in an agent economy can rely on costly identity. Each agent posts a bond before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed if it signs false claims. An echo of past behavior helps peers spot fresh accounts that copy established ones, and a kernel of signed attestations lets each vote be traced. A raven-like watch on new identities slows mass sign-ups, so cloned agents cannot cheaply outvote honest peers.
